steps.title: Crystallize Time route
steps.rule: Your spot follows your Crystallize Time debuff (and, for the pairs, NA priority west/east) and this run's slow Maelstrom side; follow the marker.

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's FollowRoute: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SlowNorthwest).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's FollowRoute: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SlowNorthwest).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on SlowNorthwest and Quietus has OffTank: false & no → SE wall; true & yes → SE wall; false & yes → near B (E 13m); true & no → SE wall.

OffTank.rule: When Quietus leaves out MT, go to the south-west wall; when Quietus includes MT, go to the south-east wall.

RegenHealer.rule: When Quietus leaves out R2, go to the south-west wall; when Quietus includes R2, go to the south-east wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on SlowNorthwest and Quietus has MainTank: false & no → SW wall; true & no → SE wall; true & yes → SW wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on SlowNorthwest and East: false & false → SW wall; true & true → SE wall; false & true → SE wall; true & false → SE wall.

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's FollowRoute: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SlowNorthwest).

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Quietus leaves out R1 and SpiritTakerTarget includes M2, go to the south-east wall; when Quietus leaves out R1 and SpiritTakerTarget leaves out M2, go to the south-west wall; when Quietus includes R1 and SpiritTakerTarget leaves out M2, go to the south-east wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's FollowRoute: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: DragonPuddles).

MeleeDpsB.rule: When Quietus leaves out OT, go to the east wall; when Quietus includes OT, go to the west wall.

RegenHealer.rule: Read the strat's FollowRoute: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Quietus has PhysRangedDps).
